prerequisites: Students must have passed at least 120 ECTS of the study plan for the degree they are pursuing.
Students who have already completed the entire study load of the degree giving them the right to obtain the title cannot participate.

learning_outcomes.text: Contribute to the comprehensive training of students, complementing their theoretical and practical teachings.
Facilitate knowledge of the appropriate work methodology for the professional reality in which students will have to operate as graduates, contrasting and applying acquired knowledge.
Promote the development of students' decision-making capacity and critical thinking.

syllabus_topics: Development of a training program, including the design of a formative project.
Specification of educational objectives and professional activities for the internship agreement.
Particular conditions of each internship placement as detailed in the Annex to the Agreement.
Formalization of educational contracts, signed by the student, both tutors, and the Center's Internship Program Manager.

assessment_methods.method: Academic Tutor's Monitoring Grade (Nota del Seguimiento)

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.5 * Internship Report Grade + 0.5 * Monitoring Grade. To pass the course, a minimum of 4 points is required in both the Internship Report Grade and the Monitoring Grade, and the final grade must be 5 or higher. If the minimum is not reached in either component, the maximum final grade will be 4 points. Extraordinary calls follow the same procedure as ordinary ones.
